threads.title: 城門爭稅
threads.lead: 城門口的一場爭執，一路傳到城外。
threads.leadEn: A row at the city gate, talked of all the way out of town.

steps.note: 城門稅務所裏，稅吏說匹帛稅重，車夫驚得張大了嘴。
steps.noteEn: At the gate's tax office the clerk names a heavy silk tax; a carter gapes.

steps.note: 城門外閒坐的人說，稅務所裏又吵起來了。
steps.noteEn: Idlers outside the gate say the tax office is quarrelling again.

steps.note: 賣卦攤上，一個客商問：城門稅重，買賣還做得成麼？
steps.noteEn: At the fortune-teller's a trader asks: with the gate tax so heavy, will my deal work?

steps.note: 棕蓋車停在路邊，車夫說城門口查得緊。
steps.noteEn: A palm-covered cart waits by the road; its carter says the gate checks are strict.

threads.title: 漕糧入城
threads.lead: 船上卸下的糧袋，一路運到城裏的正店。
threads.leadEn: Grain sacks from the boats, carried all the way to the town's wine house.

steps.note: 碼頭上卸糧，船主坐在麻袋上，記賬的一袋袋點數。
steps.noteEn: Grain is unloaded at the wharf; the owner sits on his sacks while the tally man counts.

steps.note: 扛袋的腳夫說，這些糧要運進城裏去。
steps.noteEn: The sack porters say this grain is going into town.

steps.note: 虹橋下，馱著大糧袋的驢往城裏走。
steps.noteEn: Below the Rainbow Bridge, donkeys with big grain sacks head for town.

steps.note: 城門裏，運糧的也要納稅，說是送去正店釀酒。
steps.noteEn: Inside the gate the grain carriers pay tax too: the grain is for the wine house's brewing.

steps.note: 孫羊正店門前，驢車卸下糧袋，正店要釀酒。
steps.noteEn: At the Sun Yang wine house door a donkey cart unloads grain for brewing.

threads.title: 節下的酒
threads.lead: 從腳店的新酒旗，到軍巡鋪的酒桶，再到藥鋪的招牌。
threads.leadEn: From the tavern's new-wine banner to the fire post's casks to the doctor's sign.

steps.note: 十千腳店掛著新酒旗，酒客進進出出。
steps.noteEn: The Shiqian tavern flies its new-wine banner; drinkers come and go.

steps.note: 城門內的軍巡鋪裏，弓手守著酒桶，等車來拉。
steps.noteEn: In the fire post inside the gate, archers guard the wine casks, waiting for the cart.

steps.note: 十字街口，軍車急急轉彎，說是去拉節下的酒。
steps.noteEn: At the crossroads army wagons swing round in a hurry, off to fetch the holiday wine.

steps.note: 孫羊正店樓上，酒客舉杯，說這香醪果然好。
steps.noteEn: Upstairs at the Sun Yang wine house, drinkers raise cups to the fine brew.

steps.note: 趙太丞家的招牌寫著治酒所傷，可見喝酒成風。
steps.noteEn: Doctor Zhao's sign offers a cure for drink: drinking was the fashion.

threads.title: 炭驢進城
threads.lead: 畫卷開頭的炭驢，馱的是城裏酒店灶下的炭。
threads.leadEn: The charcoal donkeys at the scroll's start carry fuel for the town's tavern stoves.

steps.note: 兩個腳夫趕著毛驢，馱著木炭往城裏去。
steps.noteEn: Two drovers drive donkeys loaded with charcoal toward town.

steps.note: 虹橋邊的小酒館，灶下燒的正是城外運來的炭。
steps.noteEn: The little tavern by the bridge burns charcoal brought from the country.

steps.note: 寺前路口，又有馱炭的驢在歇腳。
steps.noteEn: At the road by the temple, more charcoal donkeys rest.

threads.title: 郊外驚馬
threads.lead: 郊外一匹馬驚了，消息傳到了河邊。
threads.leadEn: A horse bolted in the fields, and the news reached the river.

steps.note: 郊外一匹馬驚了，幾個人跟在後面追。
steps.noteEn: Out in the fields a horse has bolted; men run after it.

steps.note: 路邊有人急喚孩子，躲開那匹驚馬。
steps.noteEn: By the road someone calls a child out of the bolting horse's way.

steps.note: 河邊歇腳的客人說，郊外有馬驚了。
steps.noteEn: Travellers resting by the river say a horse bolted out in the fields.

threads.title: 大船過橋
threads.titleEn: The Big Boat at the Bridge
threads.lead: 一艘大船險些撞上虹橋，滿橋的人都在喊。
threads.leadEn: A big boat nearly hits the Rainbow Bridge; the whole bridge shouts.

steps.note: 大船要過虹橋，船工忙著放倒桅桿。
steps.noteEn: A big boat must pass the Rainbow Bridge; the crew lower the mast.

steps.note: 橋上的人朝下喊，有人拋下繩去。
steps.noteEn: People on the bridge shout down; someone throws a rope.

steps.note: 泊在岸邊的船家說，方才虹橋底下好險。
steps.noteEn: A moored boatman says it was a close call under the Rainbow Bridge.

threads.title: 清明上墳
threads.lead: 清明時節，城裏城外都是上墳的人。
threads.leadEn: At Qingming, town and country are full of people visiting graves.

steps.note: 轎頂插著楊柳雜花，一家人上墳回城。
steps.noteEn: Willow and flowers on the sedan roof: a family back from the graves.

steps.note: 王家紙馬鋪前，有人來買上墳的紙錢。
steps.noteEn: At the Wang paper-goods shop, people buy paper money for the graves.

steps.note: 棕蓋車裏的婦人掀簾往外看，許是上墳回來。
steps.noteEn: A woman lifts the curtain of a palm-covered cart, back from the graves perhaps.

steps.note: 城裏也賣紙馬，清明了，上墳用的都有。
steps.noteEn: Paper horses are sold in town too: everything for the graves at Qingming.

threads.title: 書屏遭廢
threads.lead: 一扇草書屏風被當作苫布，推出城去。
threads.leadEn: A cursive-script screen, used as a tarp, carted out of town.

steps.note: 出城的車上蓋著一扇草書屏風，推車的直說可惜。
steps.noteEn: A cart leaving town is covered with a calligraphy screen; its pusher calls it a pity.

steps.note: 腳店門前的串車上，也蓋著一扇字屏。
steps.noteEn: The cart at the tavern door carries a calligraphy screen too.

steps.note: 士子們低聲說，元祐諸公的字如今藏不得了。
steps.noteEn: Scholars whisper that the Yuanyou men's calligraphy can no longer be kept.
